name: business_set
description: Store the sender profile printed on every proposal, contract and letter: your name, address, email, VAT id, bank details and defaults (currency, payment terms). Same profile shape as mcp-invoice. Call this once before creating documents.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Your business or freelancer name

arguments.name: address
arguments.desc: Postal address, newlines allowed

arguments.name: vat_id
arguments.desc: VAT / tax registration id

arguments.name: iban
arguments.desc: IBAN or account number for payment

arguments.name: bank
arguments.desc: Bank name / BIC

arguments.name: logo_path
arguments.desc: Path to a PNG or JPG logo for the letterhead (Pro)

arguments.name: brand_color
arguments.desc: Letterhead colour as a hex code, e.g. 1F3864 (Pro)

arguments.name: default_currency
arguments.desc: ISO code, e.g. EUR, USD. Default EUR

arguments.name: default_tax_rate
arguments.desc: Default VAT percent, quoted on proposals

arguments.name: payment_terms_days
arguments.desc: Default days until payment is due. Default 14

arguments.name: invoice_prefix
arguments.desc: Reference prefix used by mcp-invoice; kept here so one profile serves both

arguments.name: tax_rate
arguments.desc: Alias for default_tax_rate

arguments.name: vat_rate
arguments.desc: Alias for default_tax_rate

arguments.name: vat
arguments.desc: Alias for default_tax_rate

name: doc_create
description: Write a real .docx file from structured sections: headings, paragraphs, bullet or numbered lists and tables. Choose plain, letter (sender block top right, date, addressee) or proposal (letterhead band and cover title) layout. Returns the file path. Free and unlimited.

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: Document title, used as the top heading and the file name

arguments.name: sections
arguments.desc: Sections in order

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the .docx. Defaults to the data directory

arguments.name: style
arguments.desc: Layout, default plain

arguments.name: recipient
arguments.desc: Addressee block for the letter layout

arguments.name: date
arguments.desc: Date line for the letter layout, default today

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false: an existing file is never overwritten

name: doc_from_markdown
description: Turn markdown into a .docx: ATX headings, paragraphs, bullet and numbered lists, GFM pipe tables, fenced code blocks as monospace, and **bold** / *italic* / `code` inline. Returns the file path. Free and unlimited.

arguments.name: markdown
arguments.desc: The markdown source

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the .docx. Defaults to the data directory

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: Document title; defaults to the first heading in the markdown

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false: an existing file is never overwritten

name: doc_read
description: Extract the text of an existing .docx: headings with their levels, paragraphs, list items and tables, in document order. Works on files Word, Google Docs or this server produced. Free and unlimited.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Path to the .docx file

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: text (default) returns the readable text, json returns the block structure

name: doc_to_html
description: Convert a .docx to semantic HTML you can open in a browser and print to PDF. Direct PDF output is deliberately not offered: every pure-JS Word-to-PDF path needs a native dependency or a headless browser, and this server stays install-free, so printing the HTML is the supported route. Free and unlimited.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Path to the .docx file

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the .html. Defaults next to the source file

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false: an existing file is never overwritten

name: doc_fill_template
description: Replace {{placeholders}} in an existing .docx and write a new file, keeping every style, table, header, footer and image of the original. Placeholders split across runs by Word's editor are handled, because the substitution runs on the joined text of each paragraph. Call with no values to list the placeholders a template contains.

arguments.name: template_path
arguments.desc: Path to the .docx template containing {{placeholders}}

arguments.name: values
arguments.desc: Placeholder name to value, e.g. {client: "Acme", fee: "EUR 4,500.00"}

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the filled .docx. Defaults to <template>-filled.docx

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false: an existing file is never overwritten

name: proposal_create
description: Produce a client-ready .docx proposal from the parts you already know: summary, scope, deliverables, a timeline table, price and terms. Uses your business_set profile for the letterhead and allocates a reference number that is never reused. Free tier: 3 proposals or contracts per calendar month.

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Client name, printed as 'Prepared for'

arguments.name: project_title
arguments.desc: Project title

arguments.name: summary
arguments.desc: One or two paragraphs on the problem and the approach

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: What is in scope, one bullet each

arguments.name: deliverables
arguments.desc: What the client receives, one bullet each

arguments.name: timeline
arguments.desc: Phases and their durations, rendered as a table

arguments.name: valid_until
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, the date the quote expires

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false: an existing file is never overwritten

name: contract_create
description: Produce a plain freelance service agreement .docx: parties, services, term, fee and schedule, plus standard clauses on intellectual property, confidentiality, independent contractor status, liability and termination. This is a template skeleton with labelled placeholders for a lawyer to review, not legal advice. Free tier: 3 proposals or contracts per calendar month.

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: The client's legal name

arguments.name: services
arguments.desc: What you will do, one or two sentences

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, omit for an open-ended engagement

arguments.name: governing_law
arguments.desc: e.g. 'the laws of Poland'

arguments.name: clauses
arguments.desc: Extra clauses to append, one paragraph each

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false: an existing file is never overwritten

name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page
